name: B10-0116/2024 (S&D) – The cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling on China to release two imprisoned Uyghurs, Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas, and all others held arbitrarily. It asks China to guarantee them medical care, lawyers and contact with their families. It also calls on European Union countries to sanction Chinese officials linked to abuses in Xinjiang and to protect people fleeing persecution there.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** China's government, Uyghur prisoners and their families, and European Union countries.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends the text to China, European Union bodies and the United Nations.
